author: GamingBolt
description:
Since the Nintendo Switch 2’s release in 2025, the developer has made it abundantly clear that it intends to support the console the same way it supports others, and Resident Evil 2, 3, and RE4 Remakes ports are further proof of the company’s commitment to Nintendo’s hybrid device. 

Regardless of whether you’re a returning fan looking to dive back into the horror franchise’s remake offerings, or a newcomer looking for an entry point, you can’t go wrong with the Switch 2 versions of this trio of remakes.
title: Resident Evil 2 + 3 + RE4 Remake Switch 2 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 might be the name on everybody’s lips, but we always like to think outside the box. That intention has taken us on a trip down memory lane, to a time when the franchise was simpler but perhaps as effective at giving us the freedom to be as chaotic as we liked in a video game.

We’re talking about GTA 2, which could seem like we’ve gone a little too far back, but we think it’s a great way to look at how the franchise has evolved from humble beginnings, building on the strengths of its early titles while ironing out their weaknesses. This is an interesting look ahead of our time in Leonidas, and we’re happy to explain why.
title: GTA 2 Review in 2026 - Before You Play GTA 6

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re now just over two weeks away from a new part of Pywel opening its shores (get it?) to us. Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown is going to take up a lot of our free time over the rest of the year and the holidays if the base game is any indication. 

But like the original version of Pywel we’ve stuck with for the better part of the year, some things are more attractive than others. We’ve put together a few things we’re making a beeline for. While this might be subjective, we’re quite sure many of you will eagerly join our paths once you hear us out.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown - 15 Things I Can’t Wait To Try Out
